title: The Advanced Custom Fields (ACF®) WordPress plugin before 6.8.11 does not properly sanitize a stored field definition…
description: The Advanced Custom Fields (ACF®) WordPress plugin versions before 6.8.11 contain a vulnerability where a stored field definition is not properly sanitized. This flaw allows unauthenticated users to inject malicious payloads via comment handling, which are then emitted as HTML attribute names and executed as JavaScript in the browsers of visitors or administrators viewing the affected field.
